item.text: I’m doing a bigger abstraction cleanup now: predators and scavengers share the same hunger/disease/movement loop, so I’m pulling that into a common base class instead of leaving two near-duplicates in the tree. I’m also removing a duplicated “clear eaten organism from field” path while I’m in there.
